title: His brother Carl
summary: Jones has a younger brother, Carl, an army colonel with no interest in music.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: I have one brother who is, uh, seven years younger than I am. His name is Carl Jones. And he is a colonel in the United States Army, stationed in the Pentagon. Just about to retire. He's got about another year of service to go. And, uh, he'll be retiring at the ripe old age of about 40, full colonel's pay. And, uh, he has really no interest in music at all. He never did, uh, that I can remember, display any, uh, musical traits. He was a very, very intelligent boy, young man. And, uh, always did wonderfully in school. I think he majored in mathematics and Loyola. And, uh, went to the service, went through OCS, and has been there ever since.
